title: GET /reports/sales router with multi-select filters
scope: Single FastAPI router. APIRouter(prefix='/reports/sales', tags=['reports']). One endpoint: GET / with 5 optional Query(default=None) params (date_from: date | None, date_to: date | None, dealer_ids: list[int] | None, places: list[str] | None, design_ids: list[int] | None). FastAPI handles repeat-key list parsing natively (same pattern as T-053's list_sales in S2). Pure delegation — service.generate(...).

success_criteria.manual: GET /api/v1/reports/sales (no params) → 200 with full dataset. GET /api/v1/reports/sales?dealer_ids=1&dealer_ids=2&places=Mysuru → 200 with filtered dataset.
success_criteria.automated: TC-140 (200 OK with payload), TC-147 (no filters), TC-148 (all 5 filters), TC-149 (malformed list params → 422), TC-158 (SQL injection attempt safely rejected/parameterized) all pass.
success_criteria.definition_of_done: Pure delegation. response_model=SalesReportResponse. No try/except. FastAPI handles list parameter parsing — do not manually split comma-separated strings.

checkout_prompt: GET /reports/sales router created. Multi-select filters via repeated query keys, response_model=SalesReportResponse. Ready for mount in T-066.
